en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineenasws judged regarding a woman who cut off a breast of her child-bearing slave girl: ‘She is free. There is no way for her mistress upon her’. And heasws judged regarding the one who tortured his slave: ‘So he is free, there is no way for him upon him. He is a ‘Sa’iba’ (unconditionally free), he can go and give his mastership to the one he so likes to. So when he takes the responsibility of his crimes, so he would inherit him’.
